### ☀️ The sun is shining. How is the integration doing?

Kostal Piko is a hobby project and stays free. You can help in three ways:

- ⭐ **Star it on GitHub**: it makes the project easier to find
- 🐞 **Report a bug or an idea**: as an [issue](https://github.com/bertel2020/HA-kostal_piko/issues/new/choose)
- ☕ **Tip the inverter whisperer**: [Buy Me a Coffee](https://buymeacoffee.com/bertel2020) · [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/bertel2020) · [PayPal](https://paypal.me/RobertoMartins)
